First, note the given date is 1714-08-14.  
Subtract 329 days:  

1714 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, and before Gregorian reform adoption in 1752 for UK/US, but here we use Gregorian proleptic rules).  
From 1714-08-14, go back 14 days → 1714-07-31.  
From 1714-07-31, go back 31 days → 1714-06-30.  
From 1714-06-30, go back 30 days → 1714-05-31.  
From 1714-05-31, go back 31 days → 1714-04-30.  
From 1714-04-30, go back 30 days → 1714-03-31.  
From 1714-03-31, go back 31 days → 1714-02-28 (not leap year).  
From 1714-02-28, go back 28 days → 1714-01-31.  

Sum of days subtracted so far: 14+31+30+31+30+31+28 = 195 days.  
Remaining to subtract: 329 − 195 = 134 days earlier from 1714-01-31.  

From 1714-01-31, go back 31 days → 1713-12-31.  
From 1713-12-31, go back 31 days → 1713-11-30.  
From 1713-11-30, go back 30 days → 1713-10-31.  
From 1713-10-31, go back 31 days → 1713-09-30.  

Days subtracted in these steps: 31+31+30+31 = 123 days.  
Remaining: 134 − 123 = 11 days earlier from 1713-09-30.  
Subtract 11 days: 1713-09-30 → 1713-09-19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1713-09-19
